profile.headline: Senior Web Designer & Front End Website Developer | Marketing | WordPress, CRO & AEO | Figma, Elementor, GA4, GTM | Optimized 500+ sites for speed, UX & conversions | 24+ yrs experience
profile.summary:
Front-End Web Developer, WordPress Specialist, and Brand Consultant with over 20 years of experience building responsive, accessible, and high-performing websites for clients across industries. Expert in translating Figma designs into scalable, SEO-friendly WordPress builds using HTML, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript. Skilled in brand development, including logo design, visual identity systems, and style guide creation. Adept at performance optimization, email development, analytics integration, and working cross-functionally. Known for delivering thoughtful, user-first digital experiences with meticulous attention to detail in both code and creative direction.

www.kstudiofx.com

Professional Skills:
Visual Storytelling for Web
Collaborative Design-to-Dev Workflows
Conversation Design & UX Writing
Interaction Flow Architecture
Custom Wordpress Themes & Plugins
HTML & CSS, CSS Frameworks, SCSS, SASS, PHP, JQuery, JSON, MySQL  & XML
Custom HTML Email Design & Development
Style Guide & Pattern Library Development
Photography & Retouching
Conversion Optimization 
  - A/B Testing & Data-Driven UX
  - Heatmap Readings
Analytics, A/B Testing & Iteration
Proven ability to quickly pick up new tools
API Integration
Team Mentoring & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, XD
